capabilities: Render multiple image embeds as one slider
Navigate slides by swipe, click, or keyboard
Show captions under images without modifying note content
Insert a starter slider block from the command palette
Jump to a slide via a counter image list
extras: The README explicitly lists unsupported features (thumbnails, fullscreen, autoplay, video/audio/PDF, annotations, compression, compare mode, settings panel) and links to separate acceptance tests and requirements spec.
problem: Obsidian embeds images one after another, so a set of images takes up a long stretch of a note and there is no built-in way to show captions under them.
summary: Image slider plugin that renders groups of Obsidian image embeds as a swipeable slider with captions, and adds captions to ordinary image embeds.
